english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for taking an oath or emphatically saying that something is true.
Use this specifically for making a solemn oath or vow rather than an ordinary promise.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 faat3 sai6 ngo5 mou5 gong2 daai6 waa6

examples.english: I promise I didn’t take your book—I swear.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faat3 sai6 mou5 lo2 gwo3 nei5 bun2 syu1
